a11y.pendingIncidents: {count, plural, one {# incident waiting} other {# incidents waiting}}

sound.title: Sounds
sound.masterHint: Short synthesised cues, never before your first tap. Off by default on phones and tablets.
sound.alertsHint: New incidents, escalations, critical notices, failed missions.
sound.feedbackHint: Arrivals on scene, completed missions, levels, unlocks, Credits, command confirmations.

privacy.title: Privacy and app
privacy.analyticsHint: They help us improve the game. Never emails, names or free text: gameplay events only. Off until you switch them on.

pwa.title: Install the app
pwa.hint: Add Rescue Control to your home screen: it opens full screen, like an app.
pwa.installedHint: You are already using the installed app.
pwa.unavailableHint: This browser does not offer installation. Try the browser menu, or use Chrome, Edge or Safari.
pwa.inAppHint: You are in another app’s browser (TikTok, Instagram…): open the game in your own browser, from the ⋯ menu → “Open in browser”, to install it.
pwa.hintBody: Install it to open your control room with one tap, full screen.
pwa.iosIntro: Safari has no install button: it takes three steps.
pwa.iosStep1: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
pwa.iosStep2: Scroll and choose “Add to Home Screen”.
pwa.iosStep3: Confirm with “Add”: the icon appears next to your other apps.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: The control room needs a connection: the game world lives on the server and carries on without you.

manifest.description: Emergency management simulator on a real map: run your own control room.
